scale_cues: Square white dinner plate assumed about 25-26 cm across, filling most of the frame; individual blueberries (about 1.2-1.5 cm, 1.5 g each, roughly 11 counted) and the single bacon strip length (about 15 cm along its curve) used to cross-check portion sizes.
assumptions: Plate is a standard square dinner plate of about 25-26 cm
Scrambled eggs are roughly 2 large eggs' worth, cooked with a small amount of butter or oil
Cooking fat is implied by preparation and listed separately; the eggs' kcal excludes it
Chia pudding is made with unsweetened or lightly sweetened plant milk; whole milk or added sweetener would raise the calories
Bacon is one regular-cut pork strip, cooked crisp
Pineapple is fresh rather than canned in syrup
